info.name: OpenNest listing APIs with Telegram session
info.description: Manual local testing only. First finish Telegram login in the OpenNest Telegram login collection, keep the localhost cookie jar enabled, and postpone logout. This collection refreshes its own CSRF variable using that session. Requests create a real retained PAUSED draft; deletion is not implemented. Send requests individually and reuse listingId instead of repeatedly creating drafts. Media requires explicitly configured R2, actual file bytes and both ROOM/BATHROOM segments for this PG example. Storage disabled ->503; publish without required photos ->409; publish without verified contact ->403. Do not export cookies, contacts, codes or signed URLs.

item.name: 1. Refresh CSRF in the Telegram-authenticated session

request.description: Creates a retained draft in your local account. Change the fabricated sample fields before using real data; any Indian city is supported. Avoid repeated sends because listing deletion is not implemented.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Postman sample PG draft",
  "description": "Fabricated example for local API testing",
  "category": "PG_HOSTEL",
  "city": "Pune",
  "locality": "Sample locality",
  "privateAddress": "Fabricated test address",
  "latitude": 18.52,
  "longitude": 73.85,
  "monthlyRent": 5000,
  "securityDeposit": 0,
  "hasWifi": true,

exec: if ([200, 201].includes(pm.response.code)) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.version !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('version', String(data.version)); }

item.name: 4. List your drafts and published listings

request.description: PAUSED drafts are excluded even when the request uses their owner's session.

Requires enabled/configured R2. Set imageByteSize to the exact positive file byte count, imageContentType to the matching type and segment to ROOM or BATHROOM. Repeat reserve/upload/complete once for each required PG segment.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('imageId', data.imageId); pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadUrl', data.uploadUrl); pm.collectionVariables.set('uploadHeaders', JSON.stringify(data.requiredHeaders)); }

item.name: 8. Upload selected file directly to storage

request.description: Choose Body > binary and select the exact file used to calculate imageByteSize. The pre-request script applies backend-returned signed headers. This request goes directly to storage; it does not use the OpenNest CSRF header.

item.name: 9. Validate and complete the uploaded image
10. Publish after all required images validate

request.description: Requires verified contact, required images and an available publication quota. For this PG example, first complete ROOM and BATHROOM. Missing images or an exhausted quota returns 409; missing verified contact returns 403; do not bypass these checks.

exec: if ([200, 201].includes(pm.response.code)) { const data = pm.response.json(); if (data.version !== undefined) pm.collectionVariables.set('version', String(data.version)); }
